s.name: Shibuya, Shinjuku and Yokohama
s.hotel: Sequence Miyashita Park, 4 nights. Booked direct by Cynthia
s.summary: An easy first day on foot, a shrine and festival Sunday with Street Kart, the stores and Shinjuku after dark on Monday, breakfast at Tsukiji and the waterfront at Yokohama, then an early Shinkansen to Kyoto.
good_to_know: Shibuya Music Festival on Sat 17 and Sun 18. Miyashita Park, right on top of the hotel, is one of the venues. Street stages on Sunday around Dōgenzaka, Bunkamura-dori and 109.
A wander, not a destination. Many bars charge a small cover and some are regulars only. If one does not feel right, move on.
Saturday is all on foot. Everything else is a short JR ride or walk from Shibuya.

k.name: Kyoto, Nara and Osaka
k.hotel: sequence KYOTO GOJO, 3 nights. Booked on Booking.com by G
k.summary: One clear idea a day. Nara on arrival, a full day in Osaka, Fushimi Inari and Higashiyama on Friday, and a short bamboo grove morning before the train back to Tokyo.
good_to_know: Sunrise about 06:10, sunset about 17:10. In Osaka on Thursday, 17:05.
Seat D is the Fuji side in both directions. The letters don't flip. Outbound it's on your right, return it's on your left.
Kiyomizu-dera 18:00. Sanjūsangen-dō 17:00. Ginkaku-ji 17:00. Namba Yasaka Shrine about 17:00. Umeda Sky 22:30.
No Universal. Thursday is the Osaka day. Thursday and Friday can swap if they must.

g.name: Tokyo: Hibiya and Ginza
g.hotel: Hotel The Blossom Hibiya, 3 nights. Booked on Booking.com by G
g.summary: Fireworks on arrival night, a slow Sunday that turns into a full Ginza day, teamLab first thing Monday then old Tokyo at Asakusa, a casual last night in Shimbashi, and an early train to Haneda.
good_to_know: Chūō-dōri closes to cars on weekends from 12:00 to 17:00.
Closed Mondays and Fridays, so Sunday is the only day they fit.
Yūrakuchō's izakayas under the arches can take any Tokyo night.
Everything this leg is walkable or a 10 minute taxi from the hotel, plus the Ginza line direct to Asakusa on Monday.

h.name: Hong Kong
h.hotel: Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers, 3 nights. Harbour view king with club lounge. Booked on Agoda by Cynthia
h.summary: Optional pool time in the sunny hours and evenings in the city. Thursday is the Big Buddha day. Friday has a late checkout: pool, yum cha, a spare afternoon and Ozone at sunset before the 00:30 flight. Wednesday, Thursday and Friday can swap to suit the weather.
good_to_know: Late October is usually dry and in the mid to high 20s. Sunset is about 17:50.
Roughly 10:00 to 14:00. Pool blocks are optional. The Sheraton deck loses the sun by late afternoon.

A Symphony of Lights runs nightly at 20:00 but is being retired in the second half of 2026, with no final date announced. Check it is still on in the week you fly. The cruise is worth doing either way.
Happy Valley is not running on Wed 28. That night's meeting is at Sha Tin, which is further out.
Red taxis cover Kowloon and Hong Kong Island, keep some cash on you. The Star Ferry, MTR and trams all take Octopus. Tsim Sha Tsui to Central is ten minutes by ferry.
